title: A seed search for a discovery controller whose latents decompose
description: By the owner's choice the concepts come from a search over networks: no seed is expected to give latents that fit well, but among many seeds one may give a network whose decision-relevant latents, after a linear change of basis, are each a short formula, and one such network is all that is needed (docs/methodology.md, grounding: one set that works is enough). This is the eighth batch: new seeds (205 to 220) of BBRv3 with the window hidden from the encoder, as experiments/controller-hidden-window.json, widths 7 and 10. Cubic is dropped: in the first batch (exp-controller-seed-search-47) none of its 16 draws is trained well and 4 fall below BBRv3 with a competing flow, and its earlier networks recover a smaller share of their directions than BBRv3's (docs/status.md, the seed search). Per cell: 40 iterations of cloning BBRv3, 120 of reinforcement learning (learning rate 0.00003, clip 0.2, noise 0.1), BBRv3 the reference of every evaluation, the best evaluated policy kept, the grounding rollouts of that policy as experiments/ground-rl-confirm.json, then experiments/ground.py decompose on those rollouts (PySR 2.7.2, at most 40 minutes, so a cell stays inside the 6-hour limit; a cell whose scoring fails or runs out of time keeps its draw and marks it decompose-failed, to be scored again). At most five cells run at once, so the search leaves the other runners free. Collect: the training report, and each draw on its own against BBRv3 on the validation episodes of exp-teachers-val-35 (experiments/versus_reference.py, each run its own group; the first batch's collect averaged the seeds of each teacher and width). Rule, fixed before any draw is scored and unchanged since the first batch: a draw is a hit when (1) it is trained well (the whole 95% interval of its log utility minus BBRv3's above -0.1, alone and with a competing flow) and (2) its latents decompose: after the window is taken out, along the latents' own axes or whitened and turned by varimax toward the sparsest linear map from the path's features, every direction whose ceiling is at least 0.1 is recovered by PySR (three PySR seeds, the best kept), with at least three distinct formulas. The decoder fed latents rebuilt from the formulas is reported and decides nothing (docs/status.md, the seed search). A hit is then run in the closed loop on its formulas, and retrained in step 4; only then are the test links read, once. The test links are not read here.
run: case "$TEACHER" in cubic) H='[]'; LR=0.0003; CLIP=0.2; NOISE=0.2;; bbr3) H='["unacked_kpkts_short_avg","unacked_kpkts_short_min","unacked_kpkts_short_max","unacked_kpkts_mid_avg","unacked_kpkts_mid_min","unacked_kpkts_mid_max","unacked_kpkts_long_avg","unacked_kpkts_long_min","unacked_kpkts_long_max","max_delivered_bdp_over_cwnd","prev_action"]'; LR=0.00003; CLIP=0.2; NOISE=0.1;; *) exit 2;; esac; R="ctl-$TEACHER-k$K-s$SEED"; jq --arg teacher "$TEACHER" --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson hides "$H" '.algo = "clone" | .teacher_cc = $teacher | .inputs = "raw" | .latents = $k | .action_max = 8 | .encoder_hides = $hides | .share_k = 0 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .critic_flows = true | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 100 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .reference_cc = "bbr3" | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 40 | .eval_every = 10 | .time_budget_s = 7200' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$OUT/spec-clone-$R.json"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$OUT/spec-clone-$R.json" "$OUT/clone-$R" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"; jq --arg from "$OUT/clone-$R" --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson hides "$H" --argjson lr "$LR" --argjson clip "$CLIP" --argjson noise "$NOISE" '.algo = "ppo" | .init_from = $from | .inputs = "raw" | .latents = $k | .action_max = 8 | .encoder_hides = $hides | .share_k = 0 | .critic_flows = true | .critic_warmup = 3 | .noise_sigma = $noise | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = $lr | .clip = $clip | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .reference_cc = "bbr3" | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20 | .time_budget_s = 8100' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$OUT/spec-rl-$R.json"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$OUT/spec-rl-$R.json" "$OUT/rl-$R" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"; mkdir -p "$OUT/$R"; cp "$OUT/rl-$R/ppo_spec.json" "$OUT/rl-$R/net1.pt" "$OUT/$R/"; cp "$OUT/rl-$R/policy-best.onnx" "$OUT/$R/policy.onnx"; cp "$OUT/rl-$R/actor-best.pt" "$OUT/$R/actor.pt"; uv run python experiments/ground.py rollouts "$OUT/$R" --fit "$OUT/setup/paths/campaign.json" --score "$OUT/setup/eval/campaign.json" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"; NJ="$(mktemp -d)"; printf "#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n" > "$NJ/julia"; chmod +x "$NJ/julia"; PATH="$NJ:$PATH" timeout 2400 uv run --with pysr==2.7.2 python experiments/ground.py decompose "$OUT/decompose-$R" --runs "$OUT/$R" || touch "$OUT/$R/decompose-failed"
collect: uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_report.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/rl-ctl-*; E="$(mktemp -d)"; for r in "$OUT"/ctl-*; do ln -s "$r" "$E/${r##*/}-s1"; done; uv run python experiments/versus_reference.py "$OUT/versus-bbr3" "$E"/* "$IN/teachers"/stock-*
